title: Compatibility component for union SES maps
statement:
theorem singleComplexOpenComparison_union_ses_compatibility
    {C : Type u} [Category C] [Abelian C] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} C]
    (A B A' B' : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (t : A ⟶ B) (t' : A' ⟶ B') (α : A ⟶ A') (β : B ⟶ B')
    (hc : t ≫ β = α ≫ t')
    {L₁ L₂ L₃ R₁ R₂ R₃ : DerivedCategory C}
    (b₁ : L₁ ⟶ R₁) (b₂ : L₂ ⟶ R₂) (b₃ : L₃ ⟶ R₃)
    (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A ≅ L₁)
    (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B ≅ L₂)
    (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (mappingCone t) ≅ L₃)
    (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj A' ≅ R₁)
    (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj B' ≅ R₂)
    (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (mappingCone t') ≅ R₃)
    (hα : DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ b₁)
    (hβ : DerivedCategory.Q.map β ≫ e₂'.hom = e₂.hom ≫ b₂)
    (hγ : DerivedCategory.Q.map (mappingCone.map t t' α β hc) ≫ e₃'.hom =
      e₃.hom ≫ b₃) :
    ∃ (P P' : ShortComplex (CochainComplex C ℤ)) (m : P ⟶ P')
      (d₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₁ ≅ L₁)
      (d₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₂ ≅ L₂)
      (d₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₃ ≅ L₃)
      (d₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₁ ≅ R₁)
      (d₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₂ ≅ R₂)
      (d₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₃ ≅ R₃),
      P.ShortExact ∧ P'.ShortExact ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₁ ≫ d₁'.hom = d₁.hom ≫ b₁ ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₂ ≫ d₂'.hom = d₂.hom ≫ b₂ ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ ≫ d₃'.hom = d₃.hom ≫ b₃

source.place: Tags 08HZ, 08HY and 0DJ9, relative restriction sequence and coefficient comparison before passing to the derived triangle; functorial cylinder replacement as in Tags 013N and 013O. Online 08HZ, 08HY, 0DJ9 read on 2026-10-14.

proof.text: For the given strict square use the explicit cylinder B ⊕ Cone(id A), inclusion (t,inr), and quotient (inr,-Cone(id,t)). The degreewise retraction and section in cyl_exact verify a split short exact row. Projection onto B is a localized isomorphism since the identity cone is contractible. The map β ⊕ Cone(α,α) is a morphism of these rows, with first component α and third component Cone(α,β). Projection onto B commutes with the middle component and β already before localization. Compose these comparisons with the six input isomorphisms and use hα, hβ and hγ.

proof_origin.place: Explicit cylinder splitting and localized middle-component equation, reused from the existing proved single-module presentation.

theorem singleComplexOpenComparison_union_ses_compatibility
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K)
    (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X') (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVqc : IsCompact (V : Set X))
    (hUVqc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X)) 
    (a : X.Opens → Arrow (schemeDerivedCategory S'))
    (P P' : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ))
    (m : P ⟶ P')
    (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₁ ≅ (a (U ⊔ V)).left)
    (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₂ ≅ (a U).left ⊞ (a V).left)
    (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₃ ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).left)
    (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₁ ≅ (a (U ⊔ V)).right)
    (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₂ ≅ (a U).right ⊞ (a V).right)
    (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₃ ≅ (a (U ⊓ V)).right)
    (hP : P.ShortExact) (hP' : P'.ShortExact) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₁ ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ (a (U ⊔ V)).hom ∧
    DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₂ ≫ e₂'.hom =
      e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map (a U).hom (a V).hom ∧
    DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ ≫ e₃'.hom = e₃.hom ≫ (a (U ⊓ V)).hom
statement_change.what: The old universal statement is false: it permits arbitrary a and m. Take identity scheme maps over Spec(Z), zero K and K′, U=V=top, and let a be constantly the identity of Q(A) for a nonzero degree-zero module complex A. Take both rows to be the split row A → A⊕A → A, with the natural six localized isomorphisms, and take m=0. The first equation then asserts 0=id on Q(A). Short exactness of the rows supplies no equation relating m to a. The corrected statement is the cylinder step of the source argument; the geometric compatible-chain-model step is stated separately and the parent conclusion is unchanged.

source.place: Cylinder construction from a prescribed strict comparison square; the relative Mayer–Vietoris comparison uses compatible models, not arbitrary rows.

citers.note: The old application to arbitrary independently chosen rows is invalid. Its unchanged conclusion is recovered by first obtaining compatible chain models and applying the corrected cylinder construction.

old_proof.text: Apply functoriality of the restriction rows and the cylinder construction to obtain the three conjugacy equations for the morphism of presentations.
